title: Enhanced Image
description: A way of presenting images with various enhancements.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: image file (files/<name> uploaded via add_file, or a full URL)

attributes.name: link
attributes.description: wrap the image in a link to this URL/file

attributes.name: card
attributes.description: card treatment; boolean flag: emit name=name (presence is truth)

attributes.name: box
attributes.description: box treatment; boolean flag: emit name=name (presence is truth)

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: pull the image out of the text column

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: figure caption shown under the image

attributes.name: figure-label-title
attributes.description: label title shown above the caption

attributes.name: round
attributes.description: round the image corners; boolean flag: emit name=name (presence is truth)

attributes.name: disable-zoom
attributes.description: turn off click-to-zoom; boolean flag: emit name=name (presence is truth)

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: display width (CSS honors only small; anything else renders at the default wide)

attributes.name: dark
attributes.description: inherited dark-mode toggle; boolean flag: emit name=name (presence is truth)

example_html: <media-image source="https://dummyimage.com/300x200/000/fff" alt="Placeholder image" card="card" citation="This is my citation."></media-image>
agent_notes: Upload the image first (add_file) and use the returned site-relative url as source. Boolean attributes take their own name as the value (card=card).
